title: Soot on the Prayer Cloth
description: Old-faith prayer cloths near Wolfpine's chapel yard have been burned from the branches. The ash looks like desecration, but one unburned scrap carries a mark too deliberate to be grief.

not_started.summary: The party has not noticed the burned prayer cloths near Wolfpine's chapel yard.

accepted.summary: The party began looking into the burned prayer cloths.

found_unburned_cloth.summary: The party found one prayer cloth that did not burn, marked beneath the ash.

revealed_mark.summary: The party recognized the ash mark as a deliberate signal, not simple vandalism.

resolved.summary: The prayer cloth matter has been resolved.
